nodes.label: Humanizer Skill
nodes.rationale: Removes signs of AI-generated writing so text sounds natural and human; built because AI prose has specific statistical tells (em dashes, rule of three, AI vocabulary) that cluster and are detectable.

nodes.label: Signs of AI Writing Patterns
nodes.rationale: Detection relies on clusters of tells rather than isolated ones, because single patterns (one em dash, curly quotes) produce false positives against legitimate human prose.

nodes.label: Voice Calibration from Writing Sample
nodes.rationale: Removing AI patterns is not enough; the rewrite must replace them with patterns from the author's own sample, otherwise sterile voiceless output is itself an AI tell.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking-Changes Agent Rule
nodes.rationale: The installed Next.js version has breaking changes vs. model training data, so agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code to avoid stale-API mistakes.

nodes.label: MedLingua App Store Launch Checklist
nodes.rationale: Splits work into repo-done items vs. account-owner-only items, ordered so long-lead-time account tasks (Apple Developer enrollment) start first.

nodes.label: API Key Proxy (launch requirement)
nodes.rationale: EXPO_PUBLIC_ env vars are inlined into the JS bundle, so shipping without a proxy would embed the OpenAI key in production binaries; the old dev key must be rotated after deploy because it was used in dev bundles.

nodes.label: Prominent Medical Disclaimer
nodes.rationale: Stating on-screen that the app is a communication aid that does not diagnose, treat, or drive clinical decisions is what supports answering 'No' to Apple's Regulated Medical Device Status question.

nodes.label: App Store Privacy Nutrition Label
nodes.rationale: Audio/photos/user content are collected but not linked to the user (no accounts, random install id only) and not used for tracking; third-party processing by OpenAI is disclosed to match in-app consent copy.

nodes.label: Expo Versioned-Docs Agent Rule
nodes.rationale: Expo has changed since model training; agents must read the exact v54.0.0 versioned docs before writing code.

nodes.label: MedLingua iOS App
nodes.rationale: Real-time two-way medical translation (English vs Spanish/Mandarin/Vietnamese/Russian) built for seniors and limited-English speakers; screen switching in App.tsx deliberately avoids a navigation library.

nodes.label: Whisper to GPT-4o to TTS Translation Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Whisper transcribes, GPT-4o translates for a medical context, OpenAI TTS speaks the result with on-device speech as automatic fallback; implemented in src/services/openai.ts.
nodes.norm_label: whisper to gpt-4o to tts translation pipeline

nodes.label: Nothing-Is-Stored Privacy Design
nodes.rationale: Transcripts live only in memory (cleared on language change, gone when the app closes) and the single temporary TTS audio file is overwritten each turn, so no user conversation data persists.

nodes.label: Quick Phrases (pre-translated, offline)
nodes.rationale: Pre-translated clinician questions and patient responses speak instantly with no network, using on-device speech for offline audio.

nodes.label: Auto-Detect Language Mode
nodes.rationale: Whisper detects which language was spoken so a single Speak button can translate in the correct direction; new languages join via WHISPER_NAME_TO_CODE in src/services/openai.ts.

nodes.label: Face-the-Patient Flip Mode
nodes.rationale: Rotates the translation 180 degrees so the phone can lie flat between two people facing each other.

nodes.label: Single-Source-of-Truth Language Config
nodes.rationale: src/config/languages.ts drives the picker, speak-button labels, Whisper hint, TTS voice, and accessibility language tags, so adding a language is a config change plus strings and phrases.

nodes.label: MedLingua Cloudflare Worker API Proxy
nodes.rationale: A ~100-line Cloudflare Worker holds the OpenAI key (encrypted secret at Cloudflare, never in the repo) so it never ships inside the app binary; the key can be rotated with wrangler secret put without an app update.

nodes.label: Per-Device Daily Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: A random per-install device id is counted in a Cloudflare KV namespace against DAILY_REQUEST_LIMIT (default 300 requests/device/day, roughly 100 conversation turns), enforcing abuse limits without accounts.

nodes.label: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_PROXY_URL Switch
nodes.rationale: When set, the app sends no API key at all, only the random per-install id; when unset (local dev), the app falls back to calling OpenAI directly with EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENAI_API_KEY.
